tasks.label: KrakenSDR: Run test suite
tasks.detail: Unit tests for DoA algorithms (MUSIC, ESPRIT, Capon, ML). No hardware needed.

tasks.label: KrakenSDR: Iridium DoA — live runner (1626.270 MHz)
tasks.detail: Live burst-gated 2D DoA on Iridium band. Reads doa_config.toml.

tasks.label: KrakenSDR: Iridium DoA — offline replay
tasks.detail: Replay a recorded session with interactive skyplot + Az/El/CFO/PAPR time-series.

tasks.label: LibreSDR: Check AD9363 connection
tasks.detail: IIO diagnostics: shows channels, frequencies and current gain of the AD9363.

tasks.label: LibreSDR: Indoor 1626 MHz — TX IRA burst (lab DoA)
tasks.detail: Simulates an Iridium NEXT satellite indoors: full LEO pass with Doppler −28→+28 kHz, 45° elevation, 90 s cycle. Gain −50 dB gives ~20 dB SNR at 1-3 m. Stop with Ctrl+C.

tasks.label: KrakenSDR: Batch reprocess + TLE plots (3 algos, ±multiburst)
tasks.detail: MUSIC/Capon/Bartlett full reprocess (el-min 5) + TLE-comparison plots, each both single-burst and with B=16 multiburst covariance (no Kalman smoothing). ~15-20 min for a 36-min session. Plots land in <session>/plots/.
tasks.command: set -e; PY=${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python3; S="${input:sessionDir}"; for a in music capon bartlett; do echo "=== $a (single-burst) ==="; $PY apps/doa_iridium/reprocess_session.py "$S" --algo $a --el-min 9; $PY scripts/plot_track_vs_tle.py "$S" --subdir doa_multi_$a --no-smooth; echo "=== $a (multiburst B=16) ==="; $PY scripts/multiburst_doa.py "$S" --subdir doa_multi_$a --window 16 --max-span-s 20 --write; $PY scripts/plot_track_vs_tle.py "$S" --subdir "doa_multi_$a"_covB16 --no-smooth; done; echo 'Batch done.'

tasks.label: iridium-toolkit: Parse .bits file
tasks.detail: Parses a RAW: lines file with iridium-parser.py from external/iridium-toolkit/.

inputs.description: Path to the .bits RAW: lines file
Path to a recorded session directory (with raw/ frames or doa/ estimates)
